recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-13813 across active narrative without altering the already-correct StructureDefinition cardinality or generated artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-13813 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ValueSet and requested changing ValueSet.expansion.identifier cardinality to 0..1 because terminology servers are not required to persist expansions or generate expansion identifiers for transient $expand results.
initial_application: The issue was applied as SVN revision 13317, represented in git by a1e1588a06e0b0faae02480aa5f109274ffb67fb, which changed source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml from 1..1 to 0..1. The current refactored source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml already has min 0 and max 1, but older narrative still said any/every expansion has or SHALL have ValueSet.expansion.identifier.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet in the active [resources] section and maps valueset to the vocab work group, so the edited source/valueset narrative is in current build scope. FHIR-5795 is the earlier issue that made the identifier 1..1, FHIR-16442 clarifies its short text as a business identifier, and FHIR-55363 later rejected making it repeat. A 2021 terminology Zulip thread explicitly reported the SHALL prose versus 0..1 cardinality conflict and tied it to FHIR-13813.
reconciliation: Changed source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml to say an expansion can include ValueSet.expansion.identifier, and changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to say the identifier is optional for transient expansions while preserving uniqueness requirements when an identifier is populated.
source_changes: source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml: changed the identification overview from saying every expansion has ValueSet.expansion.identifier to saying an expansion can include it.
source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml: clarified that ValueSet.expansion.identifier is optional for transient expansions and that uniqueness applies when an identifier is provided.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published issue made expansion.identifier uri and 1..1, establishing the mandatory rule later relaxed by FHIR-13813.
Published clarification changed the element short text to the current business-identifier wording; this reconciliation leaves that source intact.
2026 no-change decision rejected making expansion.identifier repeat and supports retaining max 1.
2017 guidance issue introduced expansion identifier prose that was not fully aligned when FHIR-13813 made the element optional.
